I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own message in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. She said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and that a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem with the store login.

I also told her I haven't seen anything in the channel saying it was fixed. The shared files have no Marrow Agrisupply account folder, so I had nothing to cross-check it against.
